findings.title: Pipeline-mode DOM-ready 'accepted' turns late [errorlabel] failures into saved_unverified, and barrier 'accepted' lets N+1 SAVE before N's load-time validation
findings.fix: Emit persistence 'accepted' only after the load-time re-scan passes (internal phase 'domready' at DOM-ready); barrier 'accepted' waits for that event; add a test that the item status is failed and N+1 gets no SAVE

findings.title: Barrier 'accepted': the wait for slot A to be done before N+2 has no named call site
findings.fix: Run awaitBarrier(slotA,'done') after N+1's DOM-ready acceptance and before N+2's boundary()

findings.title: X5 maximize-skip condition omits the driver-launched path, which also sets --window-size
findings.fix: Define the flag as 'window sized at launch (not attach mode)'
